name: YMCA Camp Mi-Te-Na
description_short: A Granite YMCA overnight camp for boys ages 8 to 15 in Alton, NH, with campfires, specialty activities, trips and socials with sister Camp Foss. Stays run one week, two weeks, one month or the full summer, June 27 to August 21, 2027.
refund_policy_summary: For a non-medical, non-emergency cancellation, you must contact the Enrollment Coordinator at least four weeks before the session starts. Deposits taken at registration are non-refundable. A medical cancellation needs a doctor's note saying the camper cannot take part. Final payment is due May 15, 2027.

source.title: Dates and Rates – YMCA Camp Mi-Te-Na

warnings: The page lists One Week Session 2A as 'July 11 - July 27'. That overlaps Session 2B (July 18-24) and is longer than a week, so July 17 was probably meant. It is recorded as printed. Confirm with the camp.
Price range covers camper sessions only. CIT sessions are $500 and Intersession Day add-ons are $200 each.
CIT sessions start on dates that differ from camper check-in (June 25 and July 23). The $500 CIT price looks low compared with camper sessions. Confirm whether it is a full or partial fee.
Intersession Days are optional add-ons for campers staying longer than 2 weeks. They are included in the One Month and Full Summer prices.
Discounts: Granite YMCA members get 10% off, Bring a Friend is 10% off per new referral, and siblings get 5% off per child. The listed prices may not reflect the member rate.
unknowns: Whether the camp is boys-only (the page mentions socials with 'Girls Camp Foss')
